post.content:
Peter Parker made the whole world forget him. Including his girlfriend. Now he's rehearsing a speech to a woman who thinks he's a stranger, his spider DNA is going through puberty part two, and the Hulk is teaching physics. 🕷️💔

This is Spider-Man: Brand New Day, DUMBED DOWN: the whole story explained, the telepath, Scorpion, the Hulk fight, the worst kiss in Marvel and the ending. Plus way too many cartoon cutaway gags.

New to Marvel? Perfect. You don't need to have seen No Way Home to follow this.
